priorityList: Cast Seed of Corruption pre-combat or to apply and refresh Corruption on all targets.
Maintain Haunt on your primary target at all times.
Maintain Agony on all targets (up to 5 targets in heavy AoE), prioritizing refreshes when duration is under 5 seconds.
In AoE (3+ targets), spend Soul Shards on Seed of Corruption if Sow the Seeds is talented.
In Cleave (2 targets) or if Sow the Seeds is not talented, spend Soul Shards on Unstable Affliction.
Use Malefic Grasp, Drain Soul, or Shadow Bolt whenever you have 2 or more stacks of Nightfall.
Cast Malefic Grasp immediately if Darkglare is about to expire to maximize its benefit.
Cast Unstable Affliction if Shard Instability is active, even in AoE scenarios.
Refresh Agony on any target if its remaining duration is less than 50% of its total length.
Activate offensive cooldowns, including trinkets, potions, and racials (like Berserking or Blood Fury), while Darkglare is active.
Use Drain Soul or Shadow Bolt as your filler when you have no other priority actions and Nightfall is not at high stacks.
